title: An Impact Model of AI on the Principles of Justice: Encompassing the Autonomous Levels of AI Legal Reasoning
reasoning: The paper provides a conceptual framework (an 'Impact Model') to analyze how AI integration into the legal system might affect the seven core principles of justice. While justice is an ethical construct, the paper does not perform an empirical evaluation or benchmark of ethics, morality, or religion, nor does it study these within LLMs specifically.
